mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LAW_SUIT WHERE DEL_YN = 'N' AND (RSLT_KIND_CD IS NULL OR RSLT_KIND_CD = 'S001')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LAW_SUIT WHERE DEL_YN = 'N' AND SUBSTR(REG_DT, 1, 6) = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LAW_SUIT_REQ WHERE STATUS_CD = 'S001'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LAW_SUIT_DOC WHERE APP_STS_CD = 'S001'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT S.SUIT_ID AS "suitId", S.CASE_NO AS "caseNo", S.CASE_NM AS "caseNm", S.COURT_NM AS "courtNm", IC.CODE_NM AS "instanceNm", SUBSTR(S.REG_DT, 1, 8) AS "regDt", NVL(S.RSLT_KIND_NM, RS.CODE_NM) AS "rsltDispNm" FROM LAW_SUIT S LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE IC ON IC.CODE_ID = 'LAW_INSTANCE' AND IC.CODE = S.INSTANCE_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE RS ON RS.CODE_ID = 'LAW_RESULT' AND RS.CODE = S.RSLT_KIND_CD WHERE S.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY S.SUIT_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5
